course_name_original: Commande des machines et des convertisseurs
prerequisites: Method and processing of electrical circuits.
TC M11 modeling of mechatronic systems

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and implement, in whole or in part, a control/command scheme for an electromechanical actuator such as an asynchronous motor, associated with its Voltage Source Pulse Width Modulation inverter to increase the efficiency of the system.
Know the principle of Pulse Width Modulation for Static Converters
Know how to apply a PWM scheme to a given converter structure, namely: DC-DC, DC-AC
Simulate a simple converter structure and its PWM scheme
Present the simulation results obtained and relate them to the content of the course handout
Know the principles of parameter identification of an asynchronous motor for its control
Know the dynamic models of the asynchronous motor
Apply the design of linear controllers for vector control of asynchronous motors

syllabus_topics: Identification and vector control of asynchronous motor
teaching_methods: Transmissive lessons with integrated practical exercises
Practical work in the form of digital manipulation: simulation
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*CC1+1*RAP1)/2. This implies equal weighting for CC1 and RAP1.
